name: member lookup by id
sql: SELECT member_id, login_name, register_time FROM public.member WHERE member_id = 100238

name: bet reconciliation join
sql: SELECT b.bet_id, b.stake, m.login_name FROM public.bet b JOIN public.member m ON m.member_id = b.member_id WHERE m.register_time >= '2026-08-01'

name: aggregate over a date range
sql: SELECT m.currency_code, COUNT(*), SUM(b.stake) FROM public.bet b JOIN public.member m ON m.member_id = b.member_id WHERE m.register_time >= '2026-08-01' GROUP BY m.currency_code

name: computed column with multiplication
sql: SELECT bet_id, stake * odds AS potential_win FROM public.bet WHERE bet_id = 55

name: cte over settled bets
sql: WITH settled AS (SELECT bet_id, win_lost FROM public.bet WHERE status = 'Settled') SELECT bet_id FROM settled WHERE win_lost > 0

name: recursive cte
sql: WITH RECURSIVE r AS (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM r WHERE n < 5) SELECT n FROM r

name: derived table
sql: SELECT x.member_id FROM (SELECT member_id FROM public.member) x

name: the view that hides a denied column
sql: SELECT member_id, login_name FROM public.member_view WHERE currency_code = 'SGD'

name: limit rather than top
sql: SELECT member_id FROM public.member ORDER BY register_time DESC LIMIT 10

name: cast
sql: SELECT bet_id, stake::text FROM public.bet WHERE status = 'Open'

name: dollar quoted literal
sql: SELECT bet_id FROM public.bet WHERE status = $$Open$$

name: escape string literal
sql: SELECT bet_id FROM public.bet WHERE status = E'Open'

name: a quoted identifier keeps its case
a keyword read as a quoted identifier
